verses.en: They, their wives, their children, their cattle, and every sojourner, hireling, and servant bought with their money put sackcloth on their loins.

verses.am: Every man and woman of Israel, and the little children, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, fell before the temple, and cast ashes upon their heads, and spread out their sackcloth before the Lord. They put sackcloth around the altar.

verses.en: They cried to YAHUAH of Yisra'el earnestly with one consent, that he would not give their children as prey, their wives as plunder, the cities of their inheritance to destruction, and the sanctuary to being profaned and being made a reproach, for the nations to rejoice at.

verses.en: YAHUAH heard their voice, and looked at their affliction. The people continued fasting many days in all Judea and Yerushalayim before the sanctuary of YAHUAH Almighty.

verses.en: And Joakim the high priest, and all the priests that stood before YAHUAH, and those who ministered to YAHUAH, had their loins dressed in sackcloth, and offered the continual burnt offering, the vows, and the free gifts of the people.

verses.en: Then Achior, the leader of all the children of Ammon, said to him, “Let my lord now hear a word from the mouth of your servant, and I will tell you the truth concerning these people who dwell in this hill country, near to the place where you dwell. verses.en: They sojourned before this in Mesopotamia, because they didn’t want to follow the elohim of their fathers, which were in the land of the Chaldeans.

verses.en: Then their YAHUAH commanded them to depart from the place where they sojourned, and to go into the land of Canaan. They lived there, and prospered with gold and silver, and with exceedingly much cattle.

verses.am: For our bondage will not be ordered to favor; but the Lord our God will turn it to dishonor.

verses.en: And now, kindred, let us show an example to our kindred, because their soul hangs upon us, and the sanctuary, the house, and the altar rest upon us.
verses.am: And now, kindred, let us show an example to our kindred, because their soul hangs upon us, and the sanctuary, the house, and the altar rest upon us.

verses.en: Besides all this let us give thanks to YAHUAH our YAHUAH, who tries us, even as he did our fathers also.
verses.am: Besides all this let us give thanks to the Lord our God, who tries us, even as he did our fathers also.

verses.en: Remember all the things which he did to Abraham, and all the things in which he tried Yitschaq, and all the things which happened to Ya'aqob in Mesopotamia of Syria, when he kept the sheep of Laban his mother’s brother.
verses.am: Remember all the things which he did to Abraham, and all the things in which he tried Isaac, and all the things which happened to Jacob in Mesopotamia of Syria, when he kept the sheep of Laban his mother’s brother.

verses.en: For he has not tried us in the fire, as he did them, to search out their hearts, neither has he taken vengeance on us; but YAHUAH does scourge them that come near to him, to admonish them.”
verses.am: For he has not tried us in the fire, as he did them, to search out their hearts, neither has he taken vengeance on us; but the Lord does scourge them that come near to him, to admonish them.”

verses.en: And Ozias said to her, “All that you have spoken, you have spoken with a good heart. There is no one who will deny your words.
verses.am: And Ozias said to her, “All that you have spoken, you have spoken with a good heart. There is no one who will deny your words.

verses.en: For this is not the first day wherein your wisdom is manifested; but from the beginning of your days all the people have known your understanding, because the disposition of your heart is good.
verses.am: For this is not the first day wherein your wisdom is manifested; but from the beginning of your days all the people have known your understanding, because the disposition of your heart is good.

verses.en: But the people were exceedingly thirsty, and compelled us to do as we spoke to them, and to bring an oath upon ourselves, which we will not break.
verses.am: But the people were exceedingly thirsty, and compelled us to do as we spoke to them, and to bring an oath upon ourselves, which we will not break.

verses.en: And now pray you for us, because you are a godly woman, and YAHUAH will send us rain to fill our cisterns, and we will faint no more.”
verses.am: And now pray you for us, because you are a godly woman, and the Lord will send us rain to fill our cisterns, and we will faint no more.”

verses.en: Then Yahudith said to them, “Hear me, and I will do a thing, which will go down to all generations among the children of our race.
verses.am: Then Judith said to them, “Hear me, and I will do a thing, which will go down to all generations among the children of our race.

verses.en: You shall all stand at the gate tonight. I will go out with my maid. Within the days after which you said that you would deliver the city to our enemies, YAHUAH will visit Yisra'el by my hand.
verses.am: You shall all stand at the gate tonight. I will go out with my maid. Within the days after which you said that you would deliver the city to our enemies, the Lord will visit Israel by my hand.

verses.en: But you shall not inquire of my act; for I will not declare it to you, until the things are finished that I will do.”
verses.am: But you shall not inquire of my act; for I will not declare it to you, until the things are finished that I will do.”

verses.en: Then Ozias and the rulers said to her, “Go in peace. May YAHUAH be before you, to take vengeance on our enemies.”
verses.am: Then Ozias and the rulers said to her, “Go in peace. May the Lord God be before you, to take vengeance on our enemies.”

verses.en: So they returned from the tent, and went to their stations.
verses.am: So they returned from the tent, and went to their stations.

verses.en: But Yahudith fell upon her face, and put ashes upon her head, and uncovered the sackcloth with which she was clothed. The incense of that evening was now being offered at Yerushalayim in the house of YAHUAH, and Yahudith cried to YAHUAH with a loud voice, and said,
verses.am: But Judith fell upon her face, and put ashes upon her head, and uncovered the sackcloth with which she was clothed. The incense of that evening was now being offered at Jerusalem in the house of God, and Judith cried to the Lord with a loud voice, and said,

verses.en: “O YAHUAH of my father Simeon, into whose hand you gave a sword to take vengeance on the strangers who loosened the belt of a virgin to defile her, uncovered the thigh to her shame, and profaned the womb to her reproach; for you said, ‘It shall not be so;’ and they did so.
verses.am: “O Lord God of my father Simeon, into whose hand you gave a sword to take vengeance on the strangers who loosened the belt of a virgin to defile her, uncovered the thigh to her shame, and profaned the womb to her reproach; for you said, ‘It shall not be so;’ and they did so.

verses.am: Therefore you gave their rulers to be slain, and their bed, Some authorities read which was ashamed for their deceit that they wrought. which was ashamed for her wo was deceived, to be dyed in blood, and struck the servants with their masters, and the masters upon their thrones;

verses.en: and gave their wives for a prey, and their daughters to be captives, and all their spoils to be divided among your dear children; which were moved with zeal for you, and abhorred the pollution of their blood, and called upon you for aid. O YAHUAH, O my YAHUAH, hear me also who am a widow.
verses.am: and gave their wives for a prey, and their daughters to be captives, and all their spoils to be divided among your dear children; which were moved with zeal for you, and abhorred the pollution of their blood, and called upon you for aid. O God, O my God, hear me also who am a widow.

verses.en: For you did the things that were before those things, and those things, and such as come after; and you planned the things which are now, and the things which are to come. The things which you planned came to pass.
verses.am: For you did the things that were before those things, and those things, and such as come after; and you planned the things which are now, and the things which are to come. The things which you planned came to pass.

verses.en: Yes, the things which you determined stood before you, and said, ‘Behold, we are here; for all your ways are prepared, and your judgement is with foreknowledge. ’
verses.am: Yes, the things which you determined stood before you, and said, ‘Behold, we are here; for all your ways are prepared, and your judgement is with foreknowledge. ’

verses.en: For, behold, the Assyrians are multiplied in their power. They are exalted with horse and rider. They have gloried in the Gr. arm. strength of their footmen. They have trusted in shield, spear, bow, and sling. They don’t know that you are YAHUAH who breaks the battles. ‘YAHUAH’ is your name.
verses.am: For, behold, the Assyrians are multiplied in their power. They are exalted with horse and rider. They have gloried in the Gr. arm. strength of their footmen. They have trusted in shield, spear, bow, and sling. They don’t know that you are the Lord who breaks the battles. ‘The Lord’ is your name.

verses.en: Break their strength in your power, and bring down their force in your wrath; for they intend to profane your sanctuary, and to defile the tabernacle where your glorious name rests, and to destroy the horn of your altar with the sword.
verses.am: Break their strength in your power, and bring down their force in your wrath; for they intend to profane your sanctuary, and to defile the tabernacle where your glorious name rests, and to destroy the horn of your altar with the sword.

verses.en: Look at their pride, and send your wrath upon their heads. Give into my hand, which am a widow, the might that I have conceived.
verses.am: Look at their pride, and send your wrath upon their heads. Give into my hand, which am a widow, the might that I have conceived.

verses.en: Strike by the deceit of my lips the servant with the prince, and the prince with his servant. Break down their stateliness by the hand of a woman.
verses.am: Strike by the deceit of my lips the servant with the prince, and the prince with his servant. Break down their stateliness by the hand of a woman.

verses.en: For your power stands not in multitude, nor your might in strong men: but you are a YAHUAH of the afflicted. You are a helper of the Gr. fewer. oppressed, an upholder of the weak, a protector of the forlorn, a savior of those who are without hope.
verses.am: For your power stands not in multitude, nor your might in strong men: but you are a God of the afflicted. You are a helper of the Gr. fewer. oppressed, an upholder of the weak, a protector of the forlorn, a savior of those who are without hope.

verses.en: Yes, yes, YAHUAH of my father, and YAHUAH of the inheritance of Yisra'el, YAHUAH of the heavens and of the earth. Creator of the waters, King Gr. of all your creation. of every creature, hear my prayer.
verses.am: Yes, yes, God of my father, and God of the inheritance of Israel, Lord of the heavens and of the earth. Creator of the waters, King Gr. of all your creation. of every creature, hear my prayer.

verses.en: Make my speech and deceit to be their wound and stripe, who intend hard things against your covenant, your hallowed house, the top of Sion, and the house of the possession of your children.
verses.am: Make my speech and deceit to be their wound and stripe, who intend hard things against your covenant, your hallowed house, the top of Sion, and the house of the possession of your children.

verses.en: Make every nation and tribe of yours to know that you are YAHUAH, YAHUAH of all power and might, and that there is none other that protects the race of Yisra'el but you.”
verses.am: Make every nation and tribe of yours to know that you are God, the God of all power and might, and that there is none other that protects the race of Israel but you.”

verses.en: It came to pass, when she had ceased to cry to YAHUAH of Yisra'el, and had finished saying all these words,
verses.am: It came to pass, when she had ceased to cry to the God of Israel, and had finished saying all these words,

verses.en: that she rose up where she had fallen down, called her maid, and went down into the house, in the which she was used to live on the Sabbath days and on her feast days.
verses.am: that she rose up where she had fallen down, called her maid, and went down into the house, in the which she was used to live on the Sabbath days and on her feast days.

verses.en: She pulled off the sackcloth which she had put on, took off the garments of her widowhood, washed her body all over with water, anointed herself with rich ointment, braided the hair of her head, and put a tiara upon it. She put on her garments of gladness, which she used to wear in the days of the life of Manasses her husband.
verses.am: She pulled off the sackcloth which she had put on, took off the garments of her widowhood, washed her body all over with water, anointed herself with rich ointment, braided the hair of her head, and put a tiara upon it. She put on her garments of gladness, which she used to wear in the days of the life of Manasses her husband.

verses.en: She took sandals for her feet, and put her chains around her, and her bracelets, her rings, her earrings, and all her jewelry, and decked herself bravely, to decieve the eyes of all men who would see her.
verses.am: She took sandals for her feet, and put her chains around her, and her bracelets, her rings, her earrings, and all her jewelry, and decked herself bravely, to decieve the eyes of all men who would see her.

verses.en: She gave her maid a leather bottle of wine and a cruse of oil, and filled a bag with parched corn, lumps of figs, and Gr. pure. fine bread. She packed all her vessels together, and laid them upon her.
verses.am: She gave her maid a leather bottle of wine and a cruse of oil, and filled a bag with parched corn, lumps of figs, and Gr. pure. fine bread. She packed all her vessels together, and laid them upon her.

verses.en: They went out to the gate of the city of Bethulia, and found Ozias and the elders of the city, Chabris and Charmis standing by it.
verses.am: They went out to the gate of the city of Bethulia, and found Ozias and the elders of the city, Chabris and Charmis standing by it.

verses.en: But when they saw her, that her countenance was altered and her apparel was changed, they wondered at her beauty very exceedingly, and said to her,
verses.am: But when they saw her, that her countenance was altered and her apparel was changed, they wondered at her beauty very exceedingly, and said to her,

verses.en: “May YAHUAH of our fathers give you favor, and accomplish your purposes to the glory of the children of Yisra'el, and to the exaltation of Yerushalayim.” Then she worshipped YAHUAH,
verses.am: “May the God of our fathers give you favor, and accomplish your purposes to the glory of the children of Israel, and to the exaltation of Jerusalem.” Then she worshipped God,

verses.en: and said to them, “Command that they open the gate of the city for me, and I will go out to accomplish the things you spoke with me about.” And they commanded the young men to open to her, as she had spoken;
verses.am: and said to them, “Command that they open the gate of the city for me, and I will go out to accomplish the things you spoke with me about.” And they commanded the young men to open to her, as she had spoken;

verses.en: and they did so. Then Yahudith went out, she, and her handmaid with her. Nhe men of the city watched her until she had gone down the mountain, until she had passed the valley, and they could see her no more.
verses.am: and they did so. Then Judith went out, she, and her handmaid with her. Nhe men of the city watched her until she had gone down the mountain, until she had passed the valley, and they could see her no more.

verses.en: They went straight onward in the valley. The watch of the Assyrians met her;
verses.am: They went straight onward in the valley. The watch of the Assyrians met her;

verses.en: and they took her, and asked her, “Of what people are you? Where are you coming from? Where are you going?” She said, “I am a daughter of the Ibrim. I am fleeing away from their presence, because they are about to be given you to be consumed.
verses.am: and they took her, and asked her, “Of what people are you? Where are you coming from? Where are you going?” She said, “I am a daughter of the Hebrews. I am fleeing away from their presence, because they are about to be given you to be consumed.

verses.en: I am coming into the presence of Holofernes the chief captain of your army, to declare words of truth. I will show him a way that he can go and win all the hill country, and there will not be lacking of his men one person, nor one life.”
verses.am: I am coming into the presence of Holofernes the chief captain of your army, to declare words of truth. I will show him a way that he can go and win all the hill country, and there will not be lacking of his men one person, nor one life.”

verses.en: Now when the men heard her words, and considered her countenance, the beauty thereof was exceeding marvelous in their eyes. They said to her,
verses.am: Now when the men heard her words, and considered her countenance, the beauty thereof was exceeding marvelous in their eyes. They said to her,

verses.en: “You have saved your life, in that you have hurried to come down to the presence of our master. Now come to his tent. Some of us will guide you until they deliver you into his hands.
verses.am: “You have saved your life, in that you have hurried to come down to the presence of our master. Now come to his tent. Some of us will guide you until they deliver you into his hands.

verses.en: But Gr. if. when you stand before him, don’t be afraid in your heart, but declare to him according to your words; and he will treat you well.”
verses.am: But Gr. if. when you stand before him, don’t be afraid in your heart, but declare to him according to your words; and he will treat you well.”

verses.en: They chose out of them a hundred men, and appointed them to accompany her and her maid; and they brought them to the tent of Holofernes.
verses.am: They chose out of them a hundred men, and appointed them to accompany her and her maid; and they brought them to the tent of Holofernes.

verses.en: And there was great excitement throughout all the camp, for her coming was reported among the tents. They came and surrounded her as she stood outside Holofernes’ tent, until they told him about her.
verses.am: And there was great excitement throughout all the camp, for her coming was reported among the tents. They came and surrounded her as she stood outside Holofernes’ tent, until they told him about her.

verses.en: They marveled at her beauty, and marveled at the children of Yisra'el because of her. Each one said to his neighbor, “Who would despise this people, that have among them such women? For it is not good that one man of them be left, seeing that, if they are let go, they will be able to deceive the whole earth.
verses.am: They marveled at her beauty, and marveled at the children of Israel because of her. Each one said to his neighbor, “Who would despise this people, that have among them such women? For it is not good that one man of them be left, seeing that, if they are let go, they will be able to deceive the whole earth.

verses.en: Those who lay near Holofernes, and all his servants, went out and brought her into the tent.
verses.am: Those who lay near Holofernes, and all his servants, went out and brought her into the tent.

verses.en: And Holofernes was resting upon his bed under the canopy, which was woven with purple, gold, emeralds, and precious stones.
verses.am: And Holofernes was resting upon his bed under the canopy, which was woven with purple, gold, emeralds, and precious stones.

verses.en: And they told him about her; and he came out into the space before his tent, with silver lamps going before him.
verses.am: And they told him about her; and he came out into the space before his tent, with silver lamps going before him.

verses.en: But when Yahudith had come before him and his servants, they all marveled at the beauty of her countenance. She fell down upon her face, and bowed down to him, but his servants raised her up.
verses.am: But when Judith had come before him and his servants, they all marveled at the beauty of her countenance. She fell down upon her face, and bowed down to him, but his servants raised her up.

verses.en: Holofernes said to her, “Woman, take courage. Don’t be afraid in your heart; for I never hurt anyone who has chosen to serve Nebuchadnezzar, the king of all the earth.
verses.am: Holofernes said to her, “Woman, take courage. Don’t be afraid in your heart; for I never hurt anyone who has chosen to serve Nebuchadnezzar, the king of all the earth.

verses.en: And now, if your people who dwell in the hill country had not slighted me, I would not have lifted up my spear against them; but they have done these things to themselves.
verses.am: And now, if your people who dwell in the hill country had not slighted me, I would not have lifted up my spear against them; but they have done these things to themselves.

verses.en: And now tell me why you fled from them and came to us; for you have come to save yourself. Take courage! You will live tonight, and hereafter;
verses.am: And now tell me why you fled from them and came to us; for you have come to save yourself. Take courage! You will live tonight, and hereafter;

verses.en: for there is no one that will wrong you, but all will treat you well, as is done to the servants of king Nebuchadnezzar my lord.”
verses.am: for there is no one that will wrong you, but all will treat you well, as is done to the servants of king Nebuchadnezzar my lord.”

verses.en: And Yahudith said to him, “Receive the words of your servant, and let your handmaid speak in your presence, and I will declare no lie to my lord this night.
verses.am: And Judith said to him, “Receive the words of your servant, and let your handmaid speak in your presence, and I will declare no lie to my lord this night.

verses.en: If you will follow the words of your handmaid, YAHUAH will bring the thing to pass perfectly with you; and my lord will not fail to accomplish his purposes.
verses.am: If you will follow the words of your handmaid, God will bring the thing to pass perfectly with you; and my lord will not fail to accomplish his purposes.

verses.en: As Nebuchadnezzar king of all the earth lives, and as his power lives, who has sent you for the preservation of every living thing, not only do men serve him by you, but also the beasts of the field, the cattle, and the birds of the sky will live through your strength, in the time of Nebuchadnezzar and of all his house.
verses.am: As Nebuchadnezzar king of all the earth lives, and as his power lives, who has sent you for the preservation of every living thing, not only do men serve him by you, but also the beasts of the field, the cattle, and the birds of the sky will live through your strength, in the time of Nebuchadnezzar and of all his house.

verses.en: For we have heard of your wisdom and the subtle plans of your soul. It has been reported in all the earth that you only are brave in all the kingdom, mighty in knowledge, and wonderful in feats of war.
verses.am: For we have heard of your wisdom and the subtle plans of your soul. It has been reported in all the earth that you only are brave in all the kingdom, mighty in knowledge, and wonderful in feats of war.

verses.en: And now as concerning the matter which Achior spoke in your council, we have heard his words; for the men of Bethulia saved him, and he declared to them all that he had spoken before you.
verses.am: And now as concerning the matter which Achior spoke in your council, we have heard his words; for the men of Bethulia saved him, and he declared to them all that he had spoken before you.

verses.en: Therefore, O lord and master, don’t neglect his word; but lay it up in your heart, for it is true; for our race will not be punished, neither will the sword prevail against them, unless they sin against their YAHUAH.
verses.am: Therefore, O lord and master, don’t neglect his word; but lay it up in your heart, for it is true; for our race will not be punished, neither will the sword prevail against them, unless they sin against their God.

verses.en: And now, that my lord be not defeated and frustrate of his purpose, and that death may fall upon them, their sin has overtaken them, wherewith they will provoke their YAHUAH to anger, whenever they do wickedness.
verses.am: And now, that my lord be not defeated and frustrate of his purpose, and that death may fall upon them, their sin has overtaken them, wherewith they will provoke their God to anger, whenever they do wickedness.

verses.en: Since their food failed them, and all their water was scant, they took counsel to lay hands upon their cattle, and determined to consume all those things which YAHUAH charged them by his laws that they should not eat.
verses.am: Since their food failed them, and all their water was scant, they took counsel to lay hands upon their cattle, and determined to consume all those things which God charged them by his laws that they should not eat.

verses.en: They are resolved to spend the first fruits of the corn, and the tenths of the wine and the oil, which they had sanctified and reserved for the priests who stand before the face of our YAHUAH in Yerushalayim; which things it is not fitting for any of the people so much as to touch with their hands.
verses.am: They are resolved to spend the first fruits of the corn, and the tenths of the wine and the oil, which they had sanctified and reserved for the priests who stand before the face of our God in Jerusalem; which things it is not fitting for any of the people so much as to touch with their hands.

verses.en: They have sent some to Yerushalayim, because they also that dwell there have done this thing, to bring them permission from the council of elders.
verses.am: They have sent some to Jerusalem, because they also that dwell there have done this thing, to bring them permission from the council of elders.

verses.en: It will be, when brings them word, and they do it, they will be given to you to be destroyed the same day.
verses.am: It will be, when brings them word, and they do it, they will be given to you to be destroyed the same day.

verses.en: Therefore I your servant, knowing all this, fled away from their presence. YAHUAH sent me to work things with you, at which all the earth will be astonished, even as many as hear it.
verses.am: Therefore I your servant, knowing all this, fled away from their presence. God sent me to work things with you, at which all the earth will be astonished, even as many as hear it.

verses.en: For your servant is religious, and serves YAHUAH of heaven day and night. Now, my lord, I will stay with you, and your servant will go out by night into the valley. I will pray to YAHUAH, and he will tell me when they have committed their sins.
verses.am: For your servant is religious, and serves the God of heaven day and night. Now, my lord, I will stay with you, and your servant will go out by night into the valley. I will pray to God, and he will tell me when they have committed their sins.

verses.en: Then I will come and show it also to you. Then you shall go out with all your army, and there will be none of them that will resist you.
verses.am: Then I will come and show it also to you. Then you shall go out with all your army, and there will be none of them that will resist you.

verses.en: And I will lead you through the midst of Judea, until you come to Yerushalayim. I will set your seat in the midst of it. You will drive them as sheep that have no shepherd, and a dog will not so much as open his mouth before you; for these things were told me according to my foreknowledge, and were declared to me, and I was sent to tell you.”
verses.am: And I will lead you through the midst of Judea, until you come to Jerusalem. I will set your seat in the midst of it. You will drive them as sheep that have no shepherd, and a dog will not so much as open his mouth before you; for these things were told me according to my foreknowledge, and were declared to me, and I was sent to tell you.”

verses.en: Her words were pleasing in the sight of Holofernes and of all his servants. They marveled at her wisdom, and said,
verses.am: Her words were pleasing in the sight of Holofernes and of all his servants. They marveled at her wisdom, and said,

verses.en: “There is not such a woman from one end of the earth to the other, for beauty of face and wisdom of words.”
verses.am: “There is not such a woman from one end of the earth to the other, for beauty of face and wisdom of words.”

verses.en: Holofernes said to her, “YAHUAH did well to send you before the people, that might would be in our hands, and destruction among those who slighted my lord.
verses.am: Holofernes said to her, “God did well to send you before the people, that might would be in our hands, and destruction among those who slighted my lord.

verses.en: And now you are beautiful in your countenance, and wise in your words. If you will do as you have spoken, your YAHUAH will be my YAHUAH, and you will dwell in the house of king Nebuchadnezzar, and will be renowned through the whole earth.”
verses.am: And now you are beautiful in your countenance, and wise in your words. If you will do as you have spoken, your God will be my God, and you will dwell in the house of king Nebuchadnezzar, and will be renowned through the whole earth.”

verses.en: He commanded that she should be brought in where his silver vessels were set, and asked that his servants should prepare some of his own meats for her, and that she should drink from his own wine.
verses.am: He commanded that she should be brought in where his silver vessels were set, and asked that his servants should prepare some of his own meats for her, and that she should drink from his own wine.

verses.en: And Yahudith said, “I will not eat of it, lest there be an occasion of stumbling: but provision will be made for me of the things that have come with me.”
verses.am: And Judith said, “I will not eat of it, lest there be an occasion of stumbling: but provision will be made for me of the things that have come with me.”

verses.en: And Holofernes said to her, “But if the things that are with you should fail, from where will we be able to give you more like it? For there is none of your race with us.”
verses.am: And Holofernes said to her, “But if the things that are with you should fail, from where will we be able to give you more like it? For there is none of your race with us.”

verses.en: And Yahudith said to him, “As your soul lives, my lord, your servant will not spend those things that are with me, until YAHUAH works by my hand the things that he has determined.”
verses.am: And Judith said to him, “As your soul lives, my lord, your servant will not spend those things that are with me, until the Lord works by my hand the things that he has determined.”

verses.en: Then Holofernes’ servants brought her into the tent, and she slept until midnight. Then she rose up toward the morning watch,
verses.am: Then Holofernes’ servants brought her into the tent, and she slept until midnight. Then she rose up toward the morning watch,

verses.en: and sent to Holofernes, saying, “Let my lord now command that they allow your servant to go out to pray.”

verses.am: For the mountains will be moved from their foundations with the waters, and the rocks will melt as wax at your presence: But you are yet merciful to those who fear you.

verses.en: For all sacrifice is little for a sweet savor, And all the fat is very little for a whole burnt offering to you; But he who fears YAHUAH is great continually.
verses.am: For all sacrifice is little for a sweet savor, And all the fat is very little for a whole burnt offering to you; But he who fears the Lord is great continually.

verses.en: “Woe to the nations who rise up against my race! YAHUAH Almighty will take vengeance on them in the day of judgement, to put fire and worms in their flesh; and they will weep and feel their pain forever.”
verses.am: “Woe to the nations who rise up against my race! The Lord Almighty will take vengeance on them in the day of judgement, to put fire and worms in their flesh; and they will weep and feel their pain forever.”

verses.en: Now when they came to Yerushalayim, they worshipped YAHUAH. When the people were purified, they offered their whole burnt offerings, their free will offerings, and their gifts.
verses.am: Now when they came to Jerusalem, they worshipped God. When the people were purified, they offered their whole burnt offerings, their free will offerings, and their gifts.

verses.en: Yahudith dedicated all Holofernes’ stuff, which the people had given her, and gave the canopy, which she had taken for herself out of his bedchamber, for a gift to YAHUAH.
verses.am: Judith dedicated all Holofernes’ stuff, which the people had given her, and gave the canopy, which she had taken for herself out of his bedchamber, for a gift to the Lord.

verses.en: And the people continued feasting in Yerushalayim before the sanctuary for three months, and Yahudith remained with them.
verses.am: And the people continued feasting in Jerusalem before the sanctuary for three months, and Judith remained with them.

verses.en: But after these days, everyone departed to his own inheritance. Yahudith went away to Bethulia, and remained in her own possession, and was honorable in her time in all the land.
verses.am: But after these days, everyone departed to his own inheritance. Judith went away to Bethulia, and remained in her own possession, and was honorable in her time in all the land.

verses.en: Many desired her, and no man knew her all the days of her life, from the day that Manasses her husband died and was gathered to his people.
verses.am: Many desired her, and no man knew her all the days of her life, from the day that Manasses her husband died and was gathered to his people.

verses.en: She increased in greatness exceedingly; and she grew old in her husband’s house, to one hundred five years, and let her maid go free. Then she died in Bethulia. They buried her in the cave of her husband Manasses.
verses.am: She increased in greatness exceedingly; and she grew old in her husband’s house, to one hundred five years, and let her maid go free. Then she died in Bethulia. They buried her in the cave of her husband Manasses.

verses.en: The house of Yisra'el mourned for her seven days. She distributed her goods before she died to all those who were nearest of kin to Manasses her husband, and to those who were nearest of her own kindred.
verses.am: The house of Israel mourned for her seven days. She distributed her goods before she died to all those who were nearest of kin to Manasses her husband, and to those who were nearest of her own kindred.

verses.en: There was no one that made the children of Yisra'el afraid any more in the days of Yahudith, nor a long time after her death.
verses.am: There was no one that made the children of Israel afraid any more in the days of Judith, nor a long time after her death.
